sloka: कामवृत्तस्त्वयं लोक: कृत्स्न: समुपवर्त्तते ।यद्वृत्ता: सन्ति राजानस्तद्वृत्ता: सन्ति हि प्रजा: ॥ २.१०९.९॥
transliteration: kāmavṛttastvayaṁ loka: kṛtsna: samupavarttate ।yadvṛttā: santi rājānastadvṛttā: santi hi prajā: ॥ 2.109.9॥

translations.english: The entire world conducts itself as per its own sweet will. Therefore the subjects will follow the same path as their kings.
